caption:
Section 8 or market rent? Same house. 🏠

In some ZIP codes, the HUD payment standard pays more than the market. Head to head:

• Rent: $1,450 vs $1,600. Section 8 wins.
• Paperwork: Section 8 means a yearly inspection and more approvals. Market rent wins.
• Cash flow: −$47 vs +$69 a month. Section 8 wins, 2–1.

But it depends on your ZIP. DealCaddie shows the HUD payment standard for every ZIP.

Example numbers: $180K house, 25% down, 7% 30-year, 23% of rent for vacancy, repairs, CapEx and management. HUD payment standards vary by ZIP and housing authority.
